title: docs(skills): give the @objectstack/skills install line for the project's own package manager
body:
Fixes #24974
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The published `@objectstack/skills` README (the npm page and tarball text), the catalog's front page (`skills/README.md`, shipped as `dist/skills/README.md`) and the `objectstack-upgrade` skill's re-install step each printed `npm install --save-dev "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p …)"` as the only install line. In a pnpm-installed project that line exits 1 with `npm error Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')` and writes nothing, and `create-objectstack` installs with pnpm when it is available. Each site now carries the shape PR #24973 gave `content/docs/**` (merged as `3a7a60af8`): the pnpm line in the block, one comment line with the npm and yarn spellings, and the rule "add the package with the manager that installed the project".

| site | old → new | notes |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/skills/README.md`, step 1 (was L28) | `npm install --save-dev "…"` → `pnpm add -D "…"`, plus the npm/yarn comment line, plus the rule paragraph with the measured npm error | the npm page; patch changeset `.changeset/24974-skills-install-line.md` (`README.md` is in the package's `files`) |
| `packages/skills/README.md`, "Keep the version in step 1" (was L40) | the bare spelling it warns about is now `pnpm add -D @objectstack/skills`, the manager step 1 prints | same sentence, same warning |
| `packages/skills/README.md`, "Which versions exist" (was L49) | `ETARGET` → `ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION` (npm: `ETARGET`; both print `No matching version found`) | step 1 is pnpm now, so the npm-only code would have become a false statement this PR introduced; the docs' exact wording (PR #24973, M5) |
| `packages/skills/README.md`, scaffolded projects (was L54) | `npx skills list` first, because `npx skills remove --all` removes every installed skill without asking | the card's second "Wanted" line; H2's only shipped hit |
| `skills/README.md` (was L11) | pnpm line plus the comment line; the rule sentence opens the next paragraph in its short form, without the error text, because the page already defers every detail to the Skills reference | governed, Tier H; net +3 lines |
| `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`, re-install step (was L129) | pnpm line plus the comment line; the step's own sentence carries the rule ("with the manager that installed the project"); the `--all` shortcut leaves the prose | governed, Tier H; net −1 line; the token ratchet is paid in the same file (H3) |

No other shipped page prints the npm-only line: `git grep -n "npm install --save-dev" origin/main` hits the three sites above, the `content/docs/**` pages PR #24973 and PR #24922 already changed, and two release-owned `CHANGELOG.md` files a code PR never edits.

## H1 to H4, measured

- **H1 holds.** On `origin/main` `62bc12930`: `packages/skills/README.md:28` and `:40`, `skills/README.md:11`, `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md:129` all carried the npm-only line.
- **H2 holds, one site.** `git grep -n "skills remove --all" origin/main -- skills/ packages/skills/` hits `packages/skills/README.md:54` and the release-owned `packages/skills/CHANGELOG.md` only. The upgrade skill named `--all` as a prose alternative beside its by-name command, never as a printed `npx skills remove --all` (see H4).
- **H3: every skills gate green; the ratchet had 16 tokens of headroom, not zero.** `check-skills-token-ratchet` reads `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` at 6172 / 6188 before and 6171 / 6188 after. The ledger: the comment line (+109 bytes) and the rule clause (+44), less the shorter prefix (−11), the dropped `--all` clause (−52) and one deleted sentence in § 2.1 (−96): "Their consumer-facing projection is `spec-changes.json` and the chain's own `--json` output", which restated the table two paragraphs above it (its "Chain result" and "D4 projection" rows). `skills/README.md` is outside the ratchet's population by construction (population 3 in its header). `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:published-files`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:closed-ceremony-text` all exit 0 on `f0b0ddc2d`.
- **H4: the docs' shape, with the rule in the step's own sentence.** The sentence an agent reads before it copies the block now ends "add `@objectstack/skills` at the installed spec's version with the manager that installed the project, copy it:", and the block's comment line gives the npm and yarn spellings as a prefix swap on an identical argument. The one silent wrong path is running `pnpm add` in an npm or yarn project, and the sentence closes it; a literal copy of the comment's `@…` fails loudly (`No matching version found`), never silently. A three-line form (one full line per manager) was weighed and dropped: two more lines and about 50 more tokens than the file has headroom for, bought for a substitution an agent already makes. The `--all` shortcut leaves the prose because the by-name command the block prints is always safe (a missing name is skipped), while `--all` needs the judgment the docs now guard with `npx skills list`: one command, no branch.

## Line budget: `skills/**`, +4 allowed

| file | + / − | net |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/README.md` | +11 / −8 | +3 |
| `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` | +6 / −7 | −1 |
| **total** | | **+2** |

`git diff --numstat 62bc1293080968f0ec8c3d31dc1f9ed8da4077df -- skills/`. The lines were paid for by deleting content (the § 2.1 sentence and the `--all` clause), not by re-wrapping.

## Tests and gates

All readings on `f0b0ddc2d`, this PR's only commit; exit codes captured before any pipe.

- `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c 'NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build'` (what `check:skill-docs` reads): `VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 94s · waited 0s`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/skills build` (sync-catalog, byte-equality against `skills/**`): exit 0. The package declares no `test` or `typecheck` script.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths, change set from the merge base): 71 commands; every one run; `--ran` verdict: `71 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 68 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED (3 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md is 6171 tokens (ceiling 6188; headroom 17)`; `54 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs`: `✓ skills/README.md`, exit 0. `pnpm check:doc-authoring`: `53 published skill files clean`, exit 0. `pnpm check:published-files`: exit 0. `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`: `457 citation(s) over 53 published file(s)`, exit 0.
- `grep -naP` for control characters over the four files: none.
- No ablation: the diff changes prose and a changeset, no tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- Base `62bc12930`; `origin/main` moved to `05b28c199` (4 commits) during the run, none touching `packages/skills/`, `skills/` or `.changeset/`; not merged (no conflict, no main-red; the merge base is unchanged).
- Three derived gates are NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: unbuilt packages this diff never touches, `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/objectql`, and the apps/adapters `dist/`): `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`. None reads the four files here; CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` is their reading.
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` refused once on the shallow clone (its fixture is pinned to `621a48760`); deepened to that commit and re-run: `48 cases pass`, exit 0.
- Out of scope, noted and not filed: `packages/skills/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/create-objectstack/CHANGELOG.md` print the npm-only line inside released entries; both are release-owned, so a correction would be a dedicated docs-only PR. Carrier: none.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么。** 三处面向客户的安装说明(npm 包页 README、技能目录首页 README、升级技能里的重装步骤)原本只给 `npm install --save-dev …` 这一行;现在改为给 pnpm 的那一行,旁边一行注释列出 npm 与 yarn 的拼法,并写明规则「用安装这个项目的包管理器来加包」。npm 包页另外把 17.x 项目的报错码补上 pnpm 的那个,并在 `npx skills remove --all` 之前加上 `npx skills list`。附一条 `@objectstack/skills` 的 patch changeset。

**为什么改。** `create-objectstack` 有 pnpm 就用 pnpm 装项目,所以脚手架出来的项目大多是 pnpm 项目;在这种项目里照抄原来那一行会直接报错退出(实测 exit 1,`edgesOut`),什么也装不上。文档站的三页上一轮已改(PR #24973),这三处是同一问题剩下的、归本车道(受管面与 npm 包页)的行。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 纯文字改动,不碰代码、不加门禁。代价:`skills/**` 两个文件合计净 +2 行(预算 +4);升级技能文件的 token 棘轮 6171/6188,靠删掉 §2.1 一句与上方表格重复的话付账,无信息损失。风险:注释行里的 `@…` 若被逐字照抄会报「找不到版本」,是响亮失败不是静默错装。回滚:revert 本 PR 唯一的一个 commit 即可,无状态、无生成物。

**席位意见。**

**你要做的。** 一个动作:在本 PR 上给出 APPROVED review(`skills/**` 是 Tier H 受管面),席位随后落地。
